opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with price sort
opportunities.description: Search JetBlue for one-way or round-trip flights between an origin and destination city on given dates, then sort results by lowest price.
steps: Type the origin city into the 'From' textbox and pick the matching suggestion.
Type the destination city into the 'To' textbox and pick the matching suggestion.
Choose trip type (Roundtrip or One-way) if it differs from the default.
Click the departure date span, and the return date span if round-trip.
Click 'Search flights'.
Click 'Continue to flight results'.
Click 'Sort & Filter', set the sort dropdown to 'Default' and choose 'Price (low to high)' (or 'Price by Core' for the Miami search), then click 'Apply'.

instances.values: From 'new york' to 'Miami'; depart 27th, return 31st (April 2023); sorted by 'Price by Core' after toggling a Points filter.
From 'New York' to 'Toronto'; set Roundtrip then One-way; depart 29th; sorted 'Price (low to high)'; opened Details.

From 'New York' (New York City area) to 'Aruba (AUA)'; 1 passenger; return Friday May 5 2023; re-run search and sorted 'Price (low to high)'. Interrupted by Budget Fastbreak sign-up at 2389–2397 then resumed.

opportunities.name: Budget careers job search by country, team, and time type
opportunities.description: Filter Budget's careers openings by country, team, and time type, optionally enter a keyword, and open a matching job posting.
steps: Click 'Careers', then 'Openings'.
Click the 'Country' button, search the searchbox and choose the country option.
Click the 'Team' button, search and choose the team option.
Click the 'Time Type' button, search and choose the time type option.
Click 'SEARCH BY JOB TITLE OR KEYWORD'.
Click a matching job link, then 'APPLY NOW' if applying.

instances.values: Country 'United States of America', Team 'Finance', Time Type 'Full time', then opened 'Accounts Payable Associate' and clicked APPLY NOW.
Country 'United States of America', Team 'Finance', Time Type 'Full time', no keyword entered; searched by job title or keyword button only.

opportunities.name: United car rental search by pickup location and dates
opportunities.description: Search United's car rental tab for a pickup city/airport and date/time range, then run the car search.
steps: Click the 'CAR' heading.
Optionally click 'Book with miles' (label).
Type the pickup city or airport into the pickup combobox and pick the suggestion.
Click the 'Pickup' textbox and select the pickup date, then the return date.
Optionally change pickup and drop-off times from their comboboxes and choose the option.
Click 'Find cars button.'

instances.values: Book with miles; pickup 'caldwell' (Caldwell); Saturday April 8 to Thursday April 13 2023; pickup 8:00 a.m., drop-off 12:00 p.m.
Pickup 'Brooklyn Central' (Brooklyn - Central, New York); Sunday April 9 to Saturday April 15 2023; default times.

opportunities.name: NPS park search by activity or topic
opportunities.description: Find national park units by selecting a category (Activity or Topic) and a value on the NPS 'Search by Activity or Topic' page, then run the search.
steps: Click 'FIND A PARK'.
Click 'Search by Activity or Topic'.
Click the 'Activity' or 'Topic' button to choose the search category.
Click the input and choose or type the activity/topic value.
Click 'Search'.

instances.values: Category 'Activity'; input value not captured in trace (input clicked without typed text).
Category 'Topic'; input clicked twice, value not captured in trace.

opportunities.name: MTA bridge and tunnel toll lookup by vehicle type
opportunities.description: Navigate the MTA site to bridge and tunnel toll rates and select a vehicle class to view toll amounts.
steps: Open the site menu and choose 'Agencies' (or click 'Fares & Tolls').
Click 'Bridges & Tunnels' or 'Bridges and Tunnels tolls'.
Click 'Tolls by vehicle' or 'Toll Rates'.
Click the vehicle type (e.g. Cars, Motorcycles).
If a specific crossing is needed, click its heading to view details.

instances.values: Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels > Tolls by vehicle > Cars.
Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls > Toll Rates > Motorcycles; opened 'Bronx-Whitestone, Throgs Neck, Robert F. Kennedy' heading.

opportunities.name: Online product search with max price and add to cart
opportunities.description: Search a shopping site for a product keyword, cap the price, open a result, and add it to the cart.
steps: Type the product keyword into the site's search box and click the search button.
Enter a maximum price in the price filter (Max / Enter Maximum Price) and click 'GO' or 'Go'.
Click a suitable product result.
Click 'ADD TO CART' or 'Add to Cart'.

instances.values: Menards: keyword 'swivel vacuum', max price 150, added the first result via 'ADD TO CART'.
Amazon: keyword 'wireless headphones', max price 100, opened 'EAORUL Active Noise Cancelling Headphones' and clicked Add to Cart.
